intro: Thailand has around 70 million people, most of them Thai-speaking Buddhists.

chapters.title: Peoples and religion
text: Central Thai is the official language, while Isan speakers in the north-east speak a language close to Lao. There are large Chinese-Thai communities, hill peoples like the Karen and Hmong in the north, and Malay Muslims in the far south.
Over 90% of people are Theravada Buddhists, and many young men spend time as monks.

chapters.title: Daily life
text: Respect for the monarchy, elders and Buddhism shapes everyday manners; people greet each other with a wai, palms pressed together. Bangkok is a huge city of over 10 million people, and Thailand is ageing quickly.

keyTerms.meaning: A Thai greeting with palms pressed together.
The oldest surviving school of Buddhism.
